source.title: On the Globality of Motor Suppression: Unexpected Events and Their Influence on Behavior and Cognition.

confidence_rationale: Establishes that unexpected events (action errors, unexpected outcomes, surprising percepts) recruit the same fronto-basal-ganglia stopping network (via the subthalamic nucleus) that implements action stopping, and that this suppression also disrupts ongoing cognition such as working memory. That supports the interrupt half of MECH-501's premise but assigns the effect to action/cognitive suppression, i.e. the MECH-090/MECH-342 territory, and says nothing about a reconstruction of the current-state estimate. Mixed at 0.4.
failure_signatures: Reading global suppression's disruption of working memory as 'state-estimate reconstruction' would be a stretch: the review describes interruption/clearing, not replacement by a less-displaced estimate.
The review is a unifying proposal; the hyperdirect/STN mediation of surprise effects is partly inferred.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Unexpected events of several kinds recruit a fronto-basal-ganglia network for stopping, projecting to the subthalamic nucleus with a putative global suppressive effect on basal-ganglia output, which interrupts action and also affects cognition (working memory, attention).
mapping.ree_translation: Biological grounding for surprise-triggered interruption of a committed trajectory, the trigger condition in MECH-501. It maps most directly onto MECH-090/MECH-342 (action authority), and so marks the part MECH-501 inherits rather than the part it adds.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Nothing in this literature shows that surprise-triggered stopping is accompanied by a backward correction of a forward-displaced state estimate; the cognitive effects described are disruption/flushing, not re-anchoring to s_hat(t). If anything, the review makes the downstream 'reconstruction' step look like the unsupported addition. The claim's asserted separation (reconstruction distinct from and downstream of decommit) is neither supported nor contradicted.
mapping.source_context: Neuron review unifying stop-signal, error, novelty and surprise literatures under a global motor suppression account.

confidence_components.notes: Strong review for the interrupt premise; low fidelity to the reconstruction step that is MECH-501's actual content.
